examples.chinese: 你想去哪家餐廳？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng qù nǎ jiā cāntīng?
examples.english: Which restaurant do you like to go to?

examples.chinese: 你想去哪家餐廳？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng qù nǎ jiā cāntīng?
examples.english: Which restaurant do you like to go to?

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳賣飲料嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng mài yǐnliào ma?
examples.english: Does this restaurant sell beverage?

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳的甜點很好吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de tiándiǎn hěn hǎochī.
examples.english: This restaurant has delicious desserts.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳人太多，我們去那家餐廳，好嗎？他們的牛肉麵很好吃，也很便宜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng rén tài duō. Wǒmen qù nà jiā cāntīng, hǎo ma? Tāmen de niúròu miàn hěn hǎochī, yě hěn piányi.
examples.english: There are too many people in this restaurant. How about that restaurant? They have delicious beef noodles, and it is also cheap.

examples.chinese: 我朋友說這家餐廳的咖啡很好喝。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ péngyǒu shuō zhè jiā cāntīng de kāfēi hěn hǎohē.
examples.english: My friend said this restaurant’s coffee is good.

examples.chinese: 那家餐廳很近，我們走路去吧！
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng hěn jìn, wǒmen zǒulù qù ba!
examples.english: That restaurant is very close; let's walk there!

examples.chinese: 這張地圖上有十多家餐廳，我們要去哪一家？
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng dìtú shàng yǒu shí duō jiā cāntīng, wǒmen yào qù nǎ yī jiā?
examples.english: There are more than ten restaurants on this map; which one do we want to go to?

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳很有名，我們常常來這裡吃飯。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng hěn yǒumíng, wǒmen chángcháng lái zhèlǐ chīfàn.
examples.english: This restaurant is very famous; we often come here to eat.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳賣很多蛋糕和冰淇淋，這樣的甜點我都很喜歡。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng mài hěn duō dàngāo hé bīngqílín, zhèyàng de tiándiǎn wǒ dōu hěn xǐhuan.
examples.english: This restaurant sells many cakes and ice cream; I like desserts like this very much.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳很特別，沒有菜單。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng hěn tèbié, méiyǒu càidān.
examples.english: This restaurant is very special; it doesn't have a menu.

examples.chinese: 我爸爸是老師，他很喜歡他的工作。他在餐廳工作，每天差不多都晚上十點回家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bàba shì lǎoshī, tā hěn xǐhuān tā de gōngzuò. Tā zài cāntīng gōngzuò, měitiān chàbuduō dōu wǎnshàng shí diǎn huí jiā.
examples.english: My dad is a teacher; he really likes his job. He works at a restaurant, and he almost always gets home around ten at night every day.

examples.chinese: 我們公司附近有很多餐廳和飲料店。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī fùjìn yǒu hěn duō cāntīng hé yǐnliào diàn.
examples.english: Near our company there are many restaurants and beverage shops.

examples.chinese: 你先往左轉，再往右轉，就到那家餐廳了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān wǎng zuǒ zhuǎn, zài wǎng yòu zhuǎn, jiù dào nà jiā cāntīng le.
examples.english: First turn left, then turn right, and you'll arrive at that restaurant.

examples.chinese: 他住的那棟大樓附近有學校，也有餐廳。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhù de nà dòng dàlóu fùjìn yǒu xuéxiào, yě yǒu cāntīng.
examples.english: Near the building where he lives there is a school, and also a restaurant.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳最辣的牛肉麵， 小程挑戰過好幾次，可惜都沒吃完。寫劇本對我來說是個很大的挑戰，但是也能得到不少收穫，所以我願意試試。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng zuì là de niúròumiàn, Xiǎo Chéng tiǎozhàn guò hǎo jǐ cì, kěxī dōu méi chī wán. Xiě jùběn duì wǒ lái shuō shì ge hěn dà de tiǎozhàn, dànshì yě néng dédào bùshǎo shōuhuò, suǒyǐ wǒ yuànyì shìshi.
examples.english: Xiao Cheng has challenged the spiciest beef noodles at this restaurant several times, but unfortunately he never finished them. Writing scripts is a big challenge for me, but I can also gain a lot from it, so I am willing to give it a try.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳不僅服務態度好，而且食物好吃又便宜，難怪大家都推薦我來嚐嚐。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng bùjǐn fúwù tàidù hǎo, érqiě shíwù hǎochī yòu piányi, nánguài dàjiā dōu tuījiàn wǒ lái chángchang.
examples.english: This restaurant not only has a good service attitude, but the food is also delicious and cheap; no wonder everyone recommended I come and try it.

examples.chinese: 我和朋友到餐廳點了好多菜，最後沒吃完，只好打包回家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé péngyou dào cāntīng diǎn le hǎo duō cài, zuìhòu méi chī wán, zhǐhǎo dǎbāo huí jiā.
examples.english: My friend and I went to a restaurant and ordered a lot of dishes. In the end, we couldn't finish them, so we had to pack them to take home.

examples.chinese: 在這家餐廳吃飯，要是滿兩千元，老闆就免費招待一盤炒青菜。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā cāntīng chīfàn, yàoshi mǎn liǎngqiān yuán, lǎobǎn jiù miǎnfèi zhāodài yī pán chǎo qīngcài.
examples.english: If you spend at least two thousand dollars at this restaurant, the owner will treat you to a free plate of stir-fried greens.

examples.chinese: 那家動物餐廳的空間很大，可以讓客人的小動物自由自在地活動。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā dòngwù cāntīng de kōngjiān hěn dà, kěyǐ ràng kèrén de xiǎo dòngwù zìyóuzìzài de huódòng.
examples.english: That animal restaurant has a lot of space, allowing guests' small pets to move around freely and fancy-free.

examples.chinese: 這棟商業大樓的規模很大，除了有很多商店、餐廳，還有電影院、健身房。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dòng shāngyè dàlóu de guīmó hěn dà, chúle yǒu hěn duō shāngdiàn, cāntīng, hái yǒu diànyǐngyuàn, jiànshēnfáng.
examples.english: The scale of this commercial building is very large; besides many shops and restaurants, there are also a movie theater and a gym.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳的菜不僅平價，還很營養，常常中午十二點前舉客滿了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de cài bùjǐn píngjià, hái hěn yíngyǎng, chángcháng zhōngwǔ shí'èr diǎn qián jiù kèmǎn le.
examples.english: This restaurant's dishes are not only affordable but also very nutritious; it is often full before 12 noon.

examples.chinese: 學生與校長當面對話，希望學校改善教學設備和校園餐廳的服務品質。聽到老闆跟經理的對話，我才知道公司新產品的銷售成績不理想。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng yǔ xiàozhǎng dāngmiàn duìhuà, xīwàng xuéxiào gǎishàn jiàoxué shèbèi hé xiàoyuán cāntīng de fúwù pǐnzhí. Tīngdào lǎobǎn gēn jīnglǐ de duìhuà, wǒ cái zhīdào gōngsī xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu chéngjì bù lǐxiǎng.
examples.english: Students had a face-to-face dialogue with the principal, hoping the school would improve teaching equipment and the service quality of the campus cafeteria. Only after hearing the dialogue between the boss and the manager did I realize that the sales performance of the company's new product was not ideal.

examples.chinese: 我打工的餐廳一到週末就客滿，忙不過來的時候，連老闆的叔叔都得來幫忙。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dǎgōng de cāntīng yí dào zhōumò jiù kèmǎn, máng bú guòlái de shíhou, lián lǎobǎn de shūshu dōu děi lái bāngmáng.
examples.english: The restaurant where I work part-time is full every weekend; when they are too busy to manage, even the boss's uncle has to come help.

examples.chinese: 古先生很重視環保，購物時會準備環保袋，在餐廳吃飯也會用環保筷。
examples.pinyin: Gǔ xiānsheng hěn zhòngshì huánbǎo, gòuwù shí huì zhǔnbèi huánbǎo dài, zài cāntīng chīfàn yě huì yòng huánbǎo kuài.
examples.english: Mr. Gu attaches great importance to environmental protection; when shopping he prepares eco-friendly bags, and when eating in restaurants he also uses eco-friendly chopsticks.

items.wordHook: 餐(meal) + 廳(hall) → the meal hall: 餐廳(restaurant).

examples.chinese: 我要先回家，再去圖書館。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào xiān huí jiā, zài qù túshūguǎn.
examples.english: I want to go home first, then go to the library.

examples.chinese: 好。我先回宿舍做功課，再跟你一起去找他。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo. Wǒ xiān huí sùshè zuò gōngkè, zài gēn nǐ yìqǐ qù zhǎo tā.
examples.english: Okay. I will go back to the dormitory to do my homework first, then I will go to see him with you.

examples.chinese: 那家咖啡廳怎麼樣？你想再去嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā kāfēitīng zěnmeyàng? Nǐ xiǎng zài qù ma?
examples.english: What do you think about that café? Would you like to go again?

examples.chinese: 沒關係，我們可以下個週末再來看。對了，妳要買鞋子吧？
examples.pinyin: Méiguānxi, wǒmen kěyǐ xià ge zhōumò zài lái kàn. Duìle, nǐ yào mǎi xiézi ba?
examples.english: It’s okay; we can come again next weekend. By the way, you want to buy shoes, don’t you?

examples.chinese: 我很忙，現在要去廚房做飯，你再去房間找吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn máng, xiànzài yào qù chúfáng zuòfàn, nǐ zài qù fángjiān zhǎo ba.
examples.english: I am very busy and I am going to the kitchen to cook now. You go check your room again.

examples.chinese: 我們先游泳，然後再去吃飯，好不好？
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiān yóuyǒng, ránhòu zài qù chīfàn, hǎo bu hǎo?
examples.english: Let's swim first, and then go eat, okay?

examples.chinese: A:你現在要回宿舍嗎？ B:還沒，我要先去吃飯再回宿舍。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ xiànzài yào huí sùshè ma? B: Hái méi, wǒ yào xiān qù chīfàn zài huí sùshè.
examples.english: A: Are you going back to the dorm now? B: Not yet; I want to go eat first and then go back to the dorm.

examples.chinese: A:你現在有空嗎？ B:我現在要跟太太出去，晚上再給你打電話。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ xiànzài yǒu kòng ma? B: Wǒ xiànzài yào gēn tàitai chūqù, wǎnshàng zài gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.
examples.english: A: Are you free now? B: I'm going out with my wife now; I'll call you again in the evening.

examples.chinese: 現在我沒有時間，明天再跟你談這個問題。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ méiyǒu shíjiān, míngtiān zài gēn nǐ tán zhège wèntí.
examples.english: I don't have time now; I'll talk about this issue with you tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 你先往左轉，再往右轉，就到那家餐廳了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān wǎng zuǒ zhuǎn, zài wǎng yòu zhuǎn, jiù dào nà jiā cāntīng le.
examples.english: First turn left, then turn right, and you'll arrive at that restaurant.

examples.chinese: 我買了三個麵包，吃了兩個了，最後一個明天再吃。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le sān gè miànbāo, chī le liǎng gè le, zuìhòu yī gè míngtiān zài chī.
examples.english: I bought three breads, I have eaten two, I will eat the last one tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 哥哥洗澡以後都先喝一瓶牛奶再睡覺。
examples.pinyin: Gēge xǐzǎo yǐhòu dōu xiān hē yì píng niúnǎi zài shuìjiào.
examples.english: After my older brother takes a shower, he always first drinks a bottle of milk and then goes to sleep.

examples.chinese: 我想先換衣服再去運動。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng xiān huàn yīfu zài qù yùndòng.
examples.english: I want to change clothes first and then go exercise.

examples.chinese: 你先幫我付，我明天再給你錢。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān bāng wǒ fù, wǒ míngtiān zài gěi nǐ qián.
examples.english: You pay for me first; I'll give you the money tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 小馬先用手機把要賣的商品全部都拍了下來，再放到網路上賣，一個星期就賣完了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Mǎ xiān yòng shǒujī bǎ yào mài de shāngpǐn quánbù dōu pāi le xiàlái, zài fàng dào wǎnglù shàng mài, yī ge xīngqī jiù mài wán le.
examples.english: Xiao Ma first used his cell phone to photograph all the products he wanted to sell, then put them online to sell, and they were sold out in a week.

examples.chinese: 出國學習語言可以了解外國的文化，再說，也可以認識外國朋友，非常值得。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó xuéxí yǔyán kěyǐ liǎojiě wàiguó de wénhuà, zàishuō, yě kěyǐ rènshi wàiguó péngyou, fēicháng zhídé.
examples.english: Going abroad to study a language can help you understand foreign cultures; moreover, you can also meet foreign friends—it's very worthwhile.

examples.chinese: 聽說小張離過三次婚，你想他還會再結婚嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō Xiǎo Zhāng lí guò sān cì hūn, nǐ xiǎng tā hái huì zài jiéhūn ma?
examples.english: I heard Xiao Zhang has been divorced three times; do you think he will get married again?

examples.chinese: 小簡向很多公司自我推薦，經過了幾個月，最後找到了滿意的工作。經過跟父母的討論，大中決定先出國遊學一年，再回來念大學。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Jiǎn xiàng hěn duō gōngsī zìwǒ tuījiàn, jīngguò le jǐ ge yuè, zuìhòu zhǎodào le mǎnyì de gōngzuò. Jīngguò gēn fùmǔ de tǎolùn, Dàzhōng juédìng xiān chūguó yóuxué yì nián, zài huílái niàn dàxué.
examples.english: Xiao Jian recommended himself to many companies; after several months, he finally found a satisfactory job. After discussing with his parents, Dazhong decided to first study abroad for a year, and then come back to attend university.

examples.chinese: 媽媽對哥哥說，以他現在剛上班的情況，不能急著買房子，得等錢存夠了再買。
examples.pinyin: Māma duì gēge shuō, yǐ tā xiànzài gāng shàngbān de qíngkuàng, bùnéng jízhe mǎi fángzi, děi děng qián cún gòu le zài mǎi.
examples.english: Mom said to older brother, "Given your current situation of just starting work, you can't rush to buy a house; you have to wait until you've saved enough money before buying."

examples.chinese: 你先別急著買，貨比三家不吃虧，多看幾家再決定吧！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān bié jízhe mǎi, huò bǐ sān jiā bù chīkuī, duō kàn jǐ jiā zài juédìng ba!
examples.english: Don't rush to buy yet; shopping around at three stores won't hurt—look at a few more stores before deciding!

examples.chinese: 那三家商店都賣相同牌子的皮包，我們最好先比個價，再決定買哪一家的。
examples.pinyin: Nà sān jiā shāngdiàn dōu mài xiāngtóng páizi de píbāo, wǒmen zuìhǎo xiān bǐ ge jià, zài juédìng mǎi nǎ yì jiā de.
examples.english: Those three stores all sell handbags of the same brand; we'd better compare prices first, then decide which one to buy from.

examples.chinese: 我最喜歡的休閒活動是爬山和露營。為了身體和心理的健康，就算再忙，假日也應該休閒一下。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuān de xiūxián huódòng shì páshān hé lùyíng. Wèile shēntǐ hé xīnlǐ de jiànkāng, jiùsuàn zài máng, jiàrì yě yīnggāi xiūxián yīxià.
examples.english: My favorite leisure activities are mountain climbing and camping. For the sake of physical and mental health, even if you're busy, you should still take some leisure time on holidays.

examples.chinese: 上次出國時，到了機場才發現沒帶護照，這次我絕對不會再忘了。
examples.pinyin: Shàng cì chūguó shí, dào le jīchǎng cái fāxiàn méi dài hùzhào, zhè cì wǒ juéduì bù huì zài wàng le.
examples.english: Last time I went abroad, I only discovered at the airport that I hadn't brought my passport; this time I absolutely will not forget again.

examples.chinese: 小何穿著綠色牛仔褲、紅襯衫，再戴上藍色的帽子，我覺得這些顏色配在一起很醜。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Hé chuānzhe lǜsè niúzǎikù, hóng chènshān, zài dài shàng lánsè de màozi, wǒ juéde zhèxiē yánsè pèi zài yīqǐ hěn chǒu.
examples.english: Xiǎo Hé is wearing green jeans, a red shirt, and then puts on a blue hat; I think these colors paired together are very ugly.

examples.chinese: 這次的露營活動因為颱風辦不成了，可以說計畫永遠沒辦法趕上變化。張老闆開會開得太久，沒趕上飛機，只好花錢再買一張機票了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de lùyíng huódòng yīnwèi táifēng bàn bù chéng le, kěyǐ shuō jìhuà yǒngyuǎn méi bànfǎ gǎnshàng biànhuà. Zhāng lǎobǎn kāihuì kāi de tài jiǔ, méi gǎnshàng fēijī, zhǐhǎo huā qián zài mǎi yī zhāng jīpiào le.
examples.english: This camping activity couldn't be held because of the typhoon; you could say that plans can never catch up with changes. Boss Zhang's meeting went on too long, and he didn't catch the plane, so he had no choice but to spend money to buy another ticket.

examples.chinese: 醫生一再警告韓先生絕對不能再喝酒了，要不然他的身體情況就會更糟了。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng yízài jǐnggào Hán xiānsheng juéduì bù néng zài hējiǔ le, yàobùrán tā de shēntǐ qíngkuàng jiù huì gèng zāo le.
examples.english: The doctor repeatedly warned Mr. Han that he absolutely must not drink alcohol anymore; otherwise his physical condition would get worse.

examples.chinese: 那個老闆做生意不老實，一再跟客人保證商品沒問題，其實是騙人的。
examples.pinyin: Nàge lǎobǎn zuò shēngyì bù lǎoshí, yīzài gēn kèrén bǎozhèng shāngpǐn méi wèntí, qíshí shì piànrén de.
examples.english: That boss is not honest in doing business; he repeatedly assures customers that the products have no problems, but actually it's a scam.

examples.chinese: 小李好幾次約女網友見面，都被拒絕，所以不再跟她聯絡了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ hǎojǐ cì yuē nǚ wǎngyǒu jiànmiàn, dōu bèi jùjué, suǒyǐ bù zài gēn tā liánluò le.
examples.english: Xiao Li asked his female online friend to meet several times but was rejected each time, so he no longer contacts her.

examples.chinese: 不少人批評那家健身中心教練的教學品質很差，以後絕對不會再去了。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo rén pīpíng nà jiā jiànshēn zhōngxīn jiàoliàn de jiàoxué pǐnzhí hěn chà, yǐhòu juéduì bú huì zài qù le.
examples.english: Many people criticize that fitness center's coaches' teaching quality as very poor; they will absolutely not go there again.

examples.chinese: 太太：你喝醉了，別再喝了。 先生：好啦，好啦，還剩下一口，喝完就不喝了。
examples.pinyin: Tàitai: Nǐ hē zuì le, bié zài hē le. Xiānsheng: Hǎo la, hǎo la, hái shèngxià yī kǒu, hē wán jiù bù hē le.
examples.english: Wife: You're drunk; don't drink anymore. Husband: Okay, okay, there's still one sip left; after I finish it, I won't drink anymore.

examples.chinese: 這個銷售計畫很好，不過得先解決相關費用和推銷人員等現實問題。A:如果現在有一千萬從天上掉下來，那該多好啊！ B:你別再做夢了，趕快回到現實吧！
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāoshòu jìhuà hěn hǎo, bùguò děi xiān jiějué xiāngguān fèiyòng hé tuīxiāo rényuán děng xiànshí wèntí. A: Rúguǒ xiànzài yǒu yīqiān wàn cóng tiānshàng diào xiàlái, nà gāi duō hǎo a! B: Nǐ bié zài zuòmèng le, gǎnkuài huídào xiànshí ba!
examples.english: This sales plan is good, but we must first solve realistic problems such as related costs and sales personnel. A: If ten million were to fall from the sky right now, how great that would be! B: Stop dreaming and quickly return to reality!

examples.chinese: A:公司從明天起就不再提供免費的三餐了。 B:這麼重大的決定，為什麼現在才通知我們？
examples.pinyin: A: Gōngsī cóng míngtiān qǐ jiù bù zài tígōng miǎnfèi de sān cān le. B: Zhème zhòngdà de juédìng, wèishénme xiànzài cái tōngzhī wǒmen?
examples.english: A: Starting tomorrow, the company will no longer provide free three meals. B: Such a major decision—why are we only being notified now?

examples.chinese: 因為強烈颱風的關係，機場已經關了，等風小一點才會再開放。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi qiángliè táifēng de guānxì, jīchǎng yǐjīng guān le, děng fēng xiǎo yīdiǎn cái huì zài kāifàng.
examples.english: Because of the strong typhoon, the airport has already closed; it will open again only after the wind gets a little weaker.

examples.chinese: 生病的時候，最好在家休息或是去看醫生。
examples.pinyin: Shēngbìng de shíhou, zuìhǎo zài jiā xiūxi huòshì qù kàn yīshēng.
examples.english: When you're sick, you had better rest at home or go see a doctor.

examples.chinese: 生病的時候，最好在家休息或是去看醫生。
examples.pinyin: Shēngbìng de shíhou, zuìhǎo zài jiā xiūxi huòshì qù kàn yīshēng.
examples.english: When you're sick, you had better rest at home or go see a doctor.

examples.chinese: 週末的時候，我喜歡跟朋友去野餐或是露營。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò de shíhou, wǒ xǐhuān gēn péngyǒu qù yěcān huòshì lùyíng.
examples.english: On weekends, I like to go picnicking or camping with friends.

examples.chinese: 在台灣，不少人去KTV慶祝生日或是辦活動。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, bùshǎo rén qù KTV qìngzhù shēngrì huòshì bàn huódòng.
examples.english: In Taiwan, many people go to KTV to celebrate birthdays or hold events.

examples.chinese: 很多大學生利用暑假去國外旅行或是學語言。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō dàxuéshēng lìyòng shǔjià qù guówài lǚxíng huòshì xué yǔyán.
examples.english: Many college students use summer vacation to travel abroad or learn languages.

examples.chinese: 你畢業後要出國留學或是留在國內工作，都是不錯的選擇。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bìyè hòu yào chūguó liúxué huòshì liú zài guónèi gōngzuò, dōu shì bùcuò de xuǎnzé.
examples.english: After you graduate, whether you go abroad to study or stay in the country to work, both are good choices.

examples.chinese: A:我好渴，想喝可樂或是奶茶？ B:那些飲料都太甜了，不如喝水，這樣比較健康。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ hǎo kě, xiǎng hē kělè huòshì nǎichá? B: Nàxiē yǐnliào dōu tài tián le, bùrú hē shuǐ, zhèyàng bǐjiào jiànkāng.
examples.english: A: I'm so thirsty—should I drink cola or milk tea? B: Those drinks are all too sweet; it's not as good as drinking water—that's healthier.

examples.chinese: 別逼孩子做他們沒興趣或是不喜歡的事情。
examples.pinyin: Bié bī háizi zuò tāmen méi xìngqù huòshì bù xǐhuān de shìqíng.
examples.english: Don't force children to do things they're not interested in or don't like.

examples.chinese: 有了無線網路，就可以隨時隨地上網查資料、看影片，或是玩遊戲。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu le wúxiàn wǎnglù, jiù kěyǐ suíshísuídì shàngwǎng chá zīliào, kàn yǐngpiàn, huòshì wán yóuxì.
examples.english: With wireless internet, you can go online anytime, anywhere to look up information, watch videos, or play games.

examples.chinese: 鞋子的尺寸很重要，太大或是太小都不舒服。
examples.pinyin: Xiézi de chǐcùn hěn zhòngyào, tài dà huòshì tài xiǎo dōu bù shūfu.
examples.english: The size of shoes is very important; whether too big or too small, they are uncomfortable.

examples.chinese: 想要泡出一壺好茶或是一杯好咖啡，都是需要功夫的。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎngyào pào chū yī hú hǎo chá huòshì yī bēi hǎo kāfēi, dōu shì xūyào gōngfu de.
examples.english: To brew a good pot of tea or a good cup of coffee, both require effort.

examples.chinese: 後天就要開學了，你的課本都買了嗎？
examples.pinyin: Hòutiān jiù yào kāixué le, nǐ de kèběn dōu mǎi le ma?
examples.english: School starts the day after tomorrow; have you bought all your textbooks?

examples.chinese: 學校規定新生必須在開學前一週完成註冊手續。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào guīdìng xīnshēng bìxū zài kāixué qián yī zhōu wánchéng zhùcè shǒuxù.
examples.english: The school stipulates that new students must complete the registration procedures one week before the semester starts.

examples.chinese: 開學典禮時校長所演講的內容又短又精彩，讓我印象很深。
examples.pinyin: Kāixué diǎnlǐ shí xiàozhǎng suǒ yǎnjiǎng de nèiróng yòu duǎn yòu jīngcǎi, ràng wǒ yìnxiàng hěn shēn.
examples.english: The content of the principal's speech at the opening ceremony was both short and wonderful; it left a deep impression on me.

examples.chinese: 昨天朋友教我的那首英文歌，我已經學會了。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān péngyou jiāo wǒ de nà shǒu Yīngwén gē, wǒ yǐjīng xuéhuì le.
examples.english: I have already learned that English song my friend taught me yesterday.

examples.chinese: 我花了大約兩萬塊錢學做法國菜，希望能夠快點兒學會。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huā le dàyuē liǎngwàn kuài qián xué zuò Fǎguó cài, xīwàng nénggòu kuài diǎnr xuéhuì.
examples.english: I spent about 20,000 dollars learning to cook French cuisine, hoping to be able to learn it quickly.

examples.chinese: 小李今天看起來比較瘦，可能是因為穿了深色衣服的關係。我妹妹剛學會游泳，就想游到水很深的地方，我覺得太危險了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ jīntiān kàn qǐlái bǐjiào shòu, kěnéng shì yīnwèi chuān le shēnsè yīfu de guānxi. Wǒ mèimei gāng xuéhuì yóuyǒng, jiù xiǎng yóu dào shuǐ hěn shēn de dìfāng, wǒ juéde tài wēixiǎn le.
examples.english: Xiao Li looks thinner today; it might be because he wore dark-colored clothes. My younger sister just learned to swim and already wants to swim to a place where the water is very deep; I think it's too dangerous.

examples.chinese: 在國外工作的那幾年，他學會了什麼問題都自己解決，不依靠別人。
examples.pinyin: Zài guówài gōngzuò de nà jǐ nián, tā xuéhuì le shénme wèntí dōu zìjǐ jiějué, bù yīkào biérén.
examples.english: In those few years working abroad, he learned to solve every problem himself, not relying on others.

examples.chinese: 一個人要學會儲蓄，需要用錢的時候，就不必擔心沒錢可用。
examples.pinyin: Yī ge rén yào xuéhuì chǔxù, xūyào yòng qián de shíhou, jiù bùbì dānxīn méi qián kě yòng.
examples.english: A person needs to learn to save money; when you need to use money, you then don't have to worry about having no money to use.

examples.chinese: 他第一次嘗試滑雪，跌了好幾次，好不容易才學會。
examples.pinyin: Tā dì yī cì chángshì huáxuě, diē le hǎo jǐ cì, hǎobùróngyì cái xuéhuì.
examples.english: He tried skiing for the first time, fell several times, and only managed to learn it with great difficulty.

examples.chinese: 我是陳老闆的助理，每天得向他報告公司的情況。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shì Chén lǎobǎn de zhùlǐ, měitiān děi xiàng tā bàogào gōngsī de qíngkuàng.
examples.english: I am Boss Chen's assistant; every day I have to report the company's situation to him.

examples.chinese: A:從學校到博物館去，應該往哪個方向走？ B:我看過地圖，應該往南走。
examples.pinyin: A: Cóng xuéxiào dào bówùguǎn qù, yīnggāi wǎng nǎge fāngxiàng zǒu? B: Wǒ kànguo dìtú, yīnggāi wǎng nán zǒu.
examples.english: A: From the school to the museum, which direction should we go? B: I've looked at the map; we should go south.

examples.chinese: 這是往博物館的方向嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǎng bówùguǎn de fāngxiàng ma?
examples.english: Is this the direction to the museum?

examples.chinese: 小簡向很多公司自我推薦，經過了幾個月，最後找到了滿意的工作。經過跟父母的討論，大中決定先出國遊學一年，再回來念大學。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Jiǎn xiàng hěn duō gōngsī zìwǒ tuījiàn, jīngguò le jǐ ge yuè, zuìhòu zhǎodào le mǎnyì de gōngzuò. Jīngguò gēn fùmǔ de tǎolùn, Dàzhōng juédìng xiān chūguó yóuxué yì nián, zài huílái niàn dàxué.
examples.english: Xiao Jian recommended himself to many companies; after several months, he finally found a satisfactory job. After discussing with his parents, Dazhong decided to first study abroad for a year, and then come back to attend university.

examples.chinese: 購物時我喜歡一個人慢慢看，不太喜歡店員一直向我推銷。
examples.pinyin: Gòuwù shí wǒ xǐhuān yí ge rén mànmàn kàn, bú tài xǐhuān diànyuán yìzhí xiàng wǒ tuīxiāo.
examples.english: When shopping, I like to look around slowly by myself; I don't really like salesclerks constantly trying to sell to me.

examples.chinese: 對不起！我昨天跟你說話的態度不好，我向你道歉，請你別生氣了。
examples.pinyin: Duìbuqǐ! Wǒ zuótiān gēn nǐ shuōhuà de tàidù bù hǎo, wǒ xiàng nǐ dàoqiàn, qǐng nǐ bié shēngqì le.
examples.english: I'm sorry! My attitude when talking to you yesterday was not good. I apologize to you; please don't be angry anymore.

examples.chinese: 我往東走，你往西走，我們兩個的方向剛好相反。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ wǎng dōng zǒu, nǐ wǎng xī zǒu, wǒmen liǎng gè de fāngxiàng gānghǎo xiāngfǎn.
examples.english: I walk east, you walk west; our two directions are exactly opposite.

examples.chinese: 電影明星一向很重視自己的穿著，合適的穿著才能讓他們更有品味、更有自信。
examples.pinyin: Diànyǐng míngxīng yīxiàng hěn zhòngshì zìjǐ de chuānzhuó, héshì de chuānzhuó cái néng ràng tāmen gèng yǒu pǐnwèi, gèng yǒu zìxìn.
examples.english: Movie stars have always attached great importance to their clothing; only suitable clothing can make them have more taste and more confidence.

examples.chinese: 陳先生身體一向挺健康的，沒想到一個小感冒就讓他病了一個多月。
examples.pinyin: Chén xiānshēng shēntǐ yīxiàng tǐng jiànkāng de, méi xiǎngdào yī gè xiǎo gǎnmào jiù ràng tā bìng le yī gè duō yuè.
examples.english: Mr. Chen has always been quite healthy; I never expected that a small cold would make him fall ill for over a month.

examples.chinese: 公司向每位員工發出健檢通知，上面寫著檢查時間、地點和需要注意的事情。地震救災人員聽到東邊大約五公尺以外的地方，有人發出求救的聲音，就立刻趕過去救人。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī xiàng měi wèi yuángōng fāchū jiànjiǎn tōngzhī, shàngmiàn xiě zhe jiǎnchá shíjiān, dìdiǎn hé xūyào zhùyì de shìqíng. Dìzhèn jiùzāi rényuán tīngdào dōngbiān dàyuē wǔ gōngchǐ yǐwài de dìfāng, yǒu rén fāchū qiújiù de shēngyīn, jiù lìkè gǎn guòqù jiù rén.
examples.english: The company sent out a health check notice to every employee, with the examination time, location, and matters needing attention written on it. Earthquake rescue workers heard someone send out a cry for help from a place about five meters to the east, so they immediately rushed over to rescue the person.

examples.chinese: 雖然藍先生是大學的校長，可是他很謙虛，經常向同事請教管理學校的方法。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán Lán xiānsheng shì dàxué de xiàozhǎng, kěshì tā hěn qiānxū, jīngcháng xiàng tóngshì qǐngjiào guǎnlǐ xuéxiào de fāngfǎ.
examples.english: Although Mr. Lan is a university president, he is very modest and often asks colleagues for advice on methods for managing the school.

examples.chinese: 有關這場火災的詳細情況，等調查結果出來以後，市長會向民眾報告。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuguān zhè chǎng huǒzāi de xiángxì qíngkuàng, děng diàochá jiéguǒ chūlái yǐhòu, shìzhǎng huì xiàng mínzhòng bàogào.
examples.english: Regarding the detailed situation of this fire, after the investigation results come out, the mayor will report to the public.

examples.chinese: 教授打算向學校申請一筆經費，進行高山地區的調查計畫。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoshòu dǎsuàn xiàng xuéxiào shēnqǐng yī bǐ jīngfèi, jìnxíng gāoshān dìqū de diàochá jìhuà.
examples.english: The professor plans to apply to the school for a sum of funding to carry out a survey project in the high mountain areas.

examples.chinese: 華人送禮最重心意，以這種方式向收禮的人表達關心與祝福。
examples.pinyin: Huárén sònglǐ zuì zhòng xīnyì, yǐ zhè zhǒng fāngshì xiàng shōu lǐ de rén biǎodá guānxīn yǔ zhùfú.
examples.english: Chinese people place the greatest value on thoughtfulness when giving gifts, using this way to express care and blessings to the recipient.

examples.chinese: 向圖書館借的書籍要是超過規定的時間沒還，可是要罰錢的。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng túshūguǎn jiè de shūjí yàoshi chāoguò guīdìng de shíjiān méi huán, kěshì yào fá qián de.
examples.english: If books borrowed from the library are not returned within the stipulated time, you will indeed be fined money.

examples.chinese: 這個地區的路規劃得不太理想，不僅沒有一條是直的，方向也有點兒亂，很容易就迷路了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge dìqū de lù guīhuà de bú tài lǐxiǎng, bùjǐn méiyǒu yì tiáo shì zhí de, fāngxiàng yě yǒudiǎnr luàn, hěn róngyì jiù mílù le.
examples.english: The roads in this area are not planned very ideally; not only is there not a single straight one, but the directions are also a bit chaotic, so it's easy to get lost.

examples.chinese: 王先生上週向他女友求婚，沒想到才過了幾天就訂婚了。
examples.pinyin: Wáng xiānsheng shàng zhōu xiàng tā nǚyǒu qiúhūn, méi xiǎngdào cái guòle jǐ tiān jiù dìnghūn le.
examples.english: Mr. Wang proposed to his girlfriend last week; unexpectedly, just a few days later they got engaged.

examples.chinese: 我們公司的大型宴會活動，一向是宣傳部門負責處理的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī de dàxíng yànhuì huódòng, yīxiàng shì xuānchuán bùmén fùzé chǔlǐ de.
examples.english: Our company's large-scale banquet events have always been handled by the publicity department.

examples.chinese: 我的親戚是數學教授，每次我有這方面的問題就向他請教。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de qīnqi shì shùxué jiàoshòu, měi cì wǒ yǒu zhè fāngmiàn de wèntí jiù xiàng tā qǐngjiào.
examples.english: My relative is a math professor; every time I have a question in this area, I consult him.

examples.chinese: 他對志工服務一向有興趣，哪怕做得又忙又累，他也願意。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì zhìgōng fúwù yīxiàng yǒu xìngqù, nǎpà zuò de yòu máng yòu lèi, tā yě yuànyì.
examples.english: He has always been interested in volunteer service; even if it is busy and tiring, he is willing to do it.

examples.chinese: 李伯伯對做家事有很多妙主意，因此附近的鄰居常向他請教。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ bóbo duì zuò jiāshì yǒu hěn duō miào zhǔyi, yīncǐ fùjìn de línjū cháng xiàng tā qǐngjiào.
examples.english: Uncle Li has many clever ideas for doing housework, so neighbors nearby often ask him for advice.

examples.chinese: 從事新工作時往往經驗不足，因此向別人請教是必需的。
examples.pinyin: Cóngshì xīn gōngzuò shí wǎngwǎng jīngyàn bùzú, yīncǐ xiàng biérén qǐngjiào shì bìxū de.
examples.english: When starting a new job, one often lacks experience, so asking others for advice is necessary.

examples.chinese: 大學畢業後，同學們就奔向自己的人生目標，五年後才聚在一起。
examples.pinyin: Dàxué bìyè hòu, tóngxuémen jiù bēn xiàng zìjǐ de rénshēng mùbiāo, wǔ nián hòu cái jù zài yīqǐ.
examples.english: After graduating from university, classmates rush toward their own life goals, and only get together five years later.

examples.chinese: 按照我國官方規定，民間辦理環保活動可向官方申請經費。
examples.pinyin: Ànzhào wǒ guó guānfāng guīdìng, mínjiān bànlǐ huánbǎo huódòng kě xiàng guānfāng shēnqǐng jīngfèi.
examples.english: According to our country's official regulations, when non-governmental organizations hold environmental activities, they can apply to the government for funding.

examples.chinese: 公司來了位新同事，老闆要我向他一一介紹公司的規定。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī lái le wèi xīn tóngshì, lǎobǎn yào wǒ xiàng tā yīyī jièshào gōngsī de guīdìng.
examples.english: A new colleague came to the company, and the boss asked me to introduce the company's rules to him one by one.

examples.chinese: 雖然他已經親自說了對不起，但還是很後悔做出那樣沒禮貌的行為，於是再度向各位道歉。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán tā yǐjīng qīnzì shuō le duìbuqǐ, dàn háishì hěn hòuhuǐ zuòchū nàyàng méi lǐmào de xíngwéi, yúshì zàidù xiàng gèwèi dàoqiàn.
examples.english: Although he has already personally said sorry, he still very much regrets having behaved so impolitely, so he once again apologizes to everyone.

examples.chinese: 他對發展新科技向來保守，不願接受人工智慧產品。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì fāzhǎn xīn kējì xiànglái bǎoshǒu, bù yuàn jiēshòu réngōng zhìhuì chǎnpǐn.
examples.english: He has always been conservative about developing new technology and is unwilling to accept artificial intelligence products.

items.wordHook: a 冂(frame) opens a 口(mouth) path → pointing 向(towards) the door.

examples.chinese: 他太晚起床，趕快刷了牙就去上班了。
examples.pinyin: Tā tài wǎn qǐchuáng, gǎnkuài shuā le yá jiù qù shàngbān le.
examples.english: He got up too late; he quickly brushed his teeth and then went to work.

examples.chinese: 我每天早上一醒來就去刷牙、洗臉，然後去附近國小的操場跑步。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang yì xǐnglái jiù qù shuāyá, xǐliǎn, ránhòu qù fùjìn guóxiǎo de cāochǎng pǎobù.
examples.english: Every morning as soon as I wake up, I go brush my teeth and wash my face, and then I go running on the playground of the nearby elementary school.

examples.chinese: 對上班族來說，上網買牙刷、內衣褲、面紙等日用品，既輕鬆又方便。
examples.pinyin: Duì shàngbānzú lái shuō, shàngwǎng mǎi yáshuā, nèiyīkù, miànzhǐ děng rìyòngpǐn, jì qīngsōng yòu fāngbiàn.
examples.english: For office workers, buying daily commodities such as toothbrushes, underwear, and tissues online is both relaxing and convenient.

examples.chinese: 牙痛時最好快點兒去看醫生，不然越忍越疼。
examples.pinyin: Yátòng shí zuìhǎo kuài diǎnr qù kàn yīshēng, bùrán yuè rěn yuè téng.
examples.english: When you have a toothache, it's best to see a doctor quickly; otherwise, the more you endure it, the more it hurts.

items.wordHook: This jagged, interlocking shape with a pointed top and a curling root looks like a molar in profile; 牙(tooth).

examples.chinese: 既然你不想衝浪，那就坐在海灘上曬曬太陽吧！
examples.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ bù xiǎng chōnglàng, nà jiù zuò zài hǎitān shàng shài shài tàiyáng ba!
examples.english: Since you don't want to surf, then just sit on the beach and soak up some sun!

examples.chinese: 既然你那麼喜歡張小姐，就應該主動一點，約她去看電影、吃個飯什麼的。
examples.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ nàme xǐhuān Zhāng xiǎojiě, jiù yīnggāi zhǔdòng yīdiǎn, yuē tā qù kàn diànyǐng, chī ge fàn shénme de.
examples.english: Since you like Miss Zhang so much, you should take the initiative a bit more—ask her out to a movie, a meal, or something.

examples.chinese: 照顧還沒成年的孩子是父母應盡的責任，無論如何，既然生了就該養他、教導他。
examples.pinyin: Zhàogù hái méi chéngnián de háizi shì fùmǔ yīng jìn de zérèn, wúlùnrúhé, jìrán shēng le jiù gāi yǎng tā, jiàodǎo tā.
examples.english: Taking care of children who are not yet adults is a responsibility parents should fulfill; in any case, since you gave birth to them, you should raise them and educate them.

examples.chinese: 你既然把工廠交給他，就得放手讓他去管理。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jìrán bǎ gōngchǎng jiāo gěi tā, jiù děi fàngshǒu ràng tā qù guǎnlǐ.
examples.english: Since you've handed the factory over to him, you must let go and let him manage it.

items.wordHook: Combining 既(bothand) and 然(certainly): 既然 means since, now that.

examples.chinese: 上課時他把筆記寫在本子上，也把重點寫在不同顏色的便條(紙)上。
examples.pinyin: Shàngkè shí tā bǎ bǐjì xiě zài běnzi shàng, yě bǎ zhòngdiǎn xiě zài bùtóng yánsè de biàntiáo (zhǐ) shàng.
examples.english: During class he wrote the notes in his notebook, and also wrote the key points on sticky notes of different colors.

examples.chinese: 康小姐的工作能力很強，能一面掌握會議的重點，一面把會議內容翻譯成外文。
examples.pinyin: Kāng xiǎojiě de gōngzuò nénglì hěn qiáng, néng yīmiàn zhǎngwò huìyì de zhòngdiǎn, yīmiàn bǎ huìyì nèiróng fānyì chéng wàiwén.
examples.english: Miss Kang's work ability is very strong; she can simultaneously grasp the key points of a meeting and translate the meeting content into a foreign language.

examples.chinese: 面試時必須穿正式的服裝，跟老闆對話時，也應表現出客氣、 謙虛的態度。
examples.pinyin: Miànshì shí bìxū chuān zhèngshì de fúzhuāng, gēn lǎobǎn duìhuà shí, yě yīng biǎoxiàn chū kèqì, qiānxū de tàidù.
examples.english: During an interview, you must wear formal clothing; when speaking with the boss, you should also show a polite and modest attitude.

examples.chinese: 時代進步了，女人在家庭和社會中的地位也跟著提高了。在古代中國，男人不應該進廚房的傳統觀念，也因為時代的改變而不同。
examples.pinyin: Shídài jìnbù le, nǚrén zài jiātíng hé shèhuì zhōng de dìwèi yě gēnzhe tígāo le. Zài gǔdài Zhōngguó, nánrén bù yīnggāi jìn chúfáng de chuántǒng guānniàn, yě yīnwèi shídài de gǎibiàn ér bùtóng.
examples.english: Times have progressed, and women's status in the family and society has risen accordingly. In ancient China, the traditional concept that men should not enter the kitchen has also changed with the times.

examples.chinese: 不知道明哲今天怎麼了？老師叫了他好幾次，他就像木頭一樣，沒有反應。九二一大地震發生得太突然，不少民眾因為來不及反應，而被困在屋裡。
examples.pinyin: Bù zhīdào Míngzhé jīntiān zěnme le? Lǎoshī jiào le tā hǎojǐ cì, tā jiù xiàng mùtou yíyàng, méiyǒu fǎnyìng. / Jiǔ'èr yī dà dìzhèn fāshēng de tài tūrán, bùshǎo mínzhòng yīnwèi láibují fǎnyìng, ér bèi kùn zài wū lǐ.
examples.english: I don't know what's wrong with Mingzhe today? The teacher called him several times, but he was like a piece of wood, without any reaction. / The 921 earthquake happened too suddenly; many people were trapped inside their houses because they didn't have time to react.

examples.chinese: A:要不是你幫忙，現在我還找不到工作呢！ B:沒什麼，朋友之間本來就應該互相幫助。
examples.pinyin: A: Yàobùshì nǐ bāngmáng, xiànzài wǒ hái zhǎo bù dào gōngzuò ne! B: Méi shénme, péngyǒu zhījiān běnlái jiù yīnggāi hùxiāng bāngzhù.
examples.english: A: If it weren't for your help, I still wouldn't have found a job now! B: It's nothing; between friends, we should help each other by nature.

examples.chinese: 有一份研究報告表示，對陌生環境適應能力越強的人，未來成功的機會也越高。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yī fèn yánjiū bàogào biǎoshì, duì mòshēng huánjìng shìyìng nénglì yuè qiáng de rén, wèilái chénggōng de jīhuì yě yuè gāo.
examples.english: A research report indicates that the stronger a person's ability to adapt to unfamiliar environments, the higher their chances of success in the future.

examples.chinese: 小馬做事又負責又認真，答應別人的事情也一定會做到，是個很可靠的人。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Mǎ zuòshì yòu fùzé yòu rènzhēn, dāying biérén de shìqíng yě yīdìng huì zuòdào, shì gè hěn kěkào de rén.
examples.english: Xiao Ma is both responsible and serious in doing things, and he will definitely do what he promises others; he is a very reliable person.

examples.chinese: 每個人的想法、看法都不一樣，要是遇到意見不同時，就應該好好地溝通。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè rén de xiǎngfǎ, kànfǎ dōu bù yīyàng, yàoshi yùdào yìjiàn bùtóng shí, jiù yīnggāi hǎohǎo de gōutōng.
examples.english: Everyone's thoughts and views are different; if you encounter a difference of opinion, you should communicate well.

examples.chinese: 我妹妹的個性太單純了，別人說什麼她都相信，難怪常吃虧。經理找你談話，只是單純地想了解你對新工作適不適應，你別緊張。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei de gèxìng tài dānchún le, biérén shuō shénme tā dōu xiāngxìn, nánguài cháng chīkuī. Jīnglǐ zhǎo nǐ tánhuà, zhǐshì dānchún de xiǎng liǎojiě nǐ duì xīn gōngzuò shì bù shì yìng, nǐ bié jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: My younger sister's personality is too pure; she believes whatever others say, no wonder she often gets taken advantage of. The manager wants to talk with you simply to understand whether you are adapting to the new job; don't be nervous.

examples.chinese: A:小張病了三天了，不但全身沒力，還發高燒。 B:最近很多人都這樣，應該是感冒了。
examples.pinyin: A: Xiǎo Zhāng bìng le sān tiān le, bùdàn quánshēn méi lì, hái fā gāoshāo. B: Zuìjìn hěn duō rén dōu zhèyàng, yīnggāi shì gǎnmào le.
examples.english: A: Xiao Zhang has been ill for three days; not only does his whole body have no strength, but he also has a high fever. B: Many people have been like this recently; it's probably a cold.

examples.chinese: 王太太把全家照顧得非常好，王先生很感謝她對家庭的貢獻。每個大學生畢業後，都應該為社會貢獻自己的專業能力。
examples.pinyin: Wáng tàitai bǎ quánjiā zhàogù de fēicháng hǎo, Wáng xiānsheng hěn gǎnxiè tā duì jiātíng de gòngxiàn. Měi gè dàxuéshēng bìyè hòu, dōu yīnggāi wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn zìjǐ de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english: Mrs. Wang takes very good care of the whole family; Mr. Wang is very grateful for her contribution to the family. After every university student graduates, they should contribute their professional abilities to society.

examples.chinese: 有一些家長對現在的升學制度不滿，認為學校不應該逼孩子寫那麼多測驗題目。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē jiāzhǎng duì xiànzài de shēngxué zhìdù bùmǎn, rènwéi xuéxiào bù yīnggāi bī háizi xiě nàme duō cèyàn tímù.
examples.english: Some parents are dissatisfied with the current school advancement system and think that schools should not force children to write so many test questions.

examples.chinese: 父母除了教導孩子做人做事的道理，也應該肯定他們的表現，讓他們更有自信。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ chúle jiàodǎo háizi zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ, yě yīnggāi kěndìng tāmen de biǎoxiàn, ràng tāmen gèng yǒu zìxìn.
examples.english: Besides teaching children the principles of how to conduct themselves and do things, parents should also affirm their performance so that they have more confidence.

examples.chinese: 我認為多看時尚雜誌、多看模特兒怎麼穿衣服，應該就能使自己的穿著更有品味。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ rènwéi duō kàn shíshàng zázhì, duō kàn mótè'er zěnme chuān yīfu, yīnggāi jiù néng shǐ zìjǐ de chuānzhuó gèng yǒu pǐnwèi.
examples.english: I think that by reading more fashion magazines and looking more at how models wear clothes, you should be able to make your own clothing more tasteful.

examples.chinese: 顏先生對吃、喝都很講究，吃牛排時應該喝什麼酒，他也很有研究。
examples.pinyin: Yán xiānsheng duì chī, hē dōu hěn jiǎngjiū, chī niúpái shí yīnggāi hē shénme jiǔ, tā yě hěn yǒu yánjiū.
examples.english: Mr. Yan is very particular about eating and drinking; he has also studied what wine should be drunk when eating steak.

examples.chinese: A:聽說明天的會跟新商品的推銷計畫有關，你要參加嗎？ B:我是公司的安全人員，這個會應該跟我無關。
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō míngtiān de huì gēn xīn shāngpǐn de tuīxiāo jìhuà yǒuguān, nǐ yào cānjiā ma? B: Wǒ shì gōngsī de ānquán rényuán, zhège huì yīnggāi gēn wǒ wúguān.
examples.english: A: I heard that tomorrow's meeting is related to the new product promotion plan; are you going to attend? B: I am the company's security personnel; this meeting should be unrelated to me.

examples.chinese: 這個我覺得最難忘的回憶應該是跟「第一次」相關的經驗，比如第一次戀愛、第一次當背包客等等。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wǒ juéde zuì nánwàng de huíyì yīnggāi shì gēn “dì yī cì” xiāngguān de jīngyàn, bǐrú dì yī cì liàn'ài, dì yī cì dāng bèibāokè děngděng.
examples.english: The most memorable memory for me, I think, should be experiences related to 'first times,' such as first love, being a backpacker for the first time, and so on.

examples.chinese: 既然你那麼喜歡張小姐，就應該主動一點，約她去看電影、吃個飯什麼的。
examples.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ nàme xǐhuān Zhāng xiǎojiě, jiù yīnggāi zhǔdòng yīdiǎn, yuē tā qù kàn diànyǐng, chī ge fàn shénme de.
examples.english: Since you like Miss Zhang so much, you should take the initiative a bit more—ask her out to a movie, a meal, or something.

examples.chinese: 我最喜歡的休閒活動是爬山和露營。為了身體和心理的健康，就算再忙，假日也應該休閒一下。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuān de xiūxián huódòng shì páshān hé lùyíng. Wèile shēntǐ hé xīnlǐ de jiànkāng, jiùsuàn zài máng, jiàrì yě yīnggāi xiūxián yīxià.
examples.english: My favorite leisure activities are mountain climbing and camping. For the sake of physical and mental health, even if you're busy, you should still take some leisure time on holidays.

examples.chinese: 沒有人知道自己的命能有多長， 所以每天都應該好好過日子。不少人相信人的命是被決定的， 誰都改變不了。
examples.pinyin: Méiyǒu rén zhīdào zìjǐ de mìng néng yǒu duō cháng, suǒyǐ měi tiān dōu yīnggāi hǎohǎo guò rìzi. Bùshǎo rén xiāngxìn rén de mìng shì bèi juédìng de, shéi dōu gǎibiàn bù liǎo.
examples.english: No one knows how long their own life can be, so every day one should live life well. Many people believe that a person's fate is decided, and no one can change it.

examples.chinese: 醫生的工作是讓病人恢復健康，甚至把寶貴的生命救回來，所以我們應該尊敬醫生。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng de gōngzuò shì ràng bìngrén huīfù jiànkāng, shènzhì bǎ bǎoguì de shēngmìng jiù huílái, suǒyǐ wǒmen yīnggāi zūnjìng yīshēng.
examples.english: A doctor's job is to help patients recover their health, and even to save precious life back, so we should respect doctors.

examples.chinese: 地震時要保護自己的安全，最重要的是避免頭部受傷。當地震發生時，我們應該怎麼做呢？
examples.pinyin: Dìzhèn shí yào bǎohù zìjǐ de ānquán, zuì zhòngyào de shì bìmiǎn tóubù shòushāng. Dāng dìzhèn fāshēng shí, wǒmen yīnggāi zěnme zuò ne?
examples.english: During an earthquake, you must protect your own safety; the most important thing is to avoid head injury. When an earthquake occurs, what should we do?

examples.chinese: 任何人都應該認真思考自己的未來，別糊里糊塗地過日子。
examples.pinyin: Rènhé rén dōu yīnggāi rènzhēn sīkǎo zìjǐ de wèilái, bié húlǐhútú de guò rìzi.
examples.english: Everyone should seriously think about their own future, and not live their days muddleheadedly.

examples.chinese: 大人應該把刀子放在安全的地方，要不然小孩子碰了，可能會受傷。
examples.pinyin: Dàrén yīnggāi bǎ dāozi fàng zài ānquán de dìfāng, yàobùrán xiǎoháizi pèng le, kěnéng huì shòushāng.
examples.english: Adults should put knives in a safe place; otherwise, if children touch them, they might get hurt.

examples.chinese: 吉米來臺灣五年了，喜歡這裡的食物和人，不過還不能適應夏天的天氣。
examples.pinyin: Jímǐ lái Táiwān wǔ nián le, xǐhuān zhèlǐ de shíwù hé rén, bùguò hái bù néng shìyìng xiàtiān de tiānqì.
examples.english: Jimmy has been in Taiwan for five years and likes the food and people here, but he still can't adapt to the summer weather.

examples.chinese: A:醫生說我應該多運動，少吃太鹹、太油的東西，這樣才不容易生病。 B:就是說嘛！我跟你說過好多次了，你怎麼不聽呢？
examples.pinyin: A: Yīshēng shuō wǒ yīnggāi duō yùndòng, shǎo chī tài xián, tài yóu de dōngxi, zhèyàng cái bù róngyì shēngbìng. B: Jiùshì shuō ma! Wǒ gēn nǐ shuō guò hǎo duō cì le, nǐ zěnme bù tīng ne?
examples.english: A: The doctor said I should exercise more and eat less of things that are too salty or too oily; this way it's not easy to get sick. B: Exactly! I've told you many times, why don't you listen?

examples.chinese: A:謝謝你的幫助。沒有你的話， 我一個人很難完成新產品的廣告設計。 B:別這麼說。我們是同事，互相幫助是應該的。
examples.pinyin: A: Xièxie nǐ de bāngzhù. Méiyǒu nǐ de huà, wǒ yīge rén hěn nán wánchéng xīn chǎnpǐn de guǎnggào shèjì. B: Bié zhème shuō. Wǒmen shì tóngshì, hùxiāng bāngzhù shì yīnggāi de.
examples.english: A: Thank you for your help. Without you, it would be very difficult for me to complete the advertising design for the new product alone. B: Don't say that. We are colleagues; helping each other is only right.

examples.chinese: 小鐘昨天晚上做了好幾個夢，沒睡好，難怪今天精神很不好。有人說，有夢最美。應該趁著年輕勇敢地做夢，更要努力讓夢想變成真的。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhōng zuótiān wǎnshang zuò le hǎo jǐ ge mèng, méi shuì hǎo, nánguài jīntiān jīngshén hěn bù hǎo. Yǒu rén shuō, yǒu mèng zuì měi. Yīnggāi chènzhe niánqīng yǒnggǎn de zuòmèng, gèng yào nǔlì ràng mèngxiǎng biànchéng zhēn de.
examples.english: Xiao Zhong had several dreams last night and didn't sleep well; no wonder he is in very low spirits today. Some people say that having dreams is the most beautiful thing. You should bravely dream while you are young, and even more, work hard to make your dreams come true.

examples.chinese: 今年的表演比去年的更有意思，我覺得你應該來看。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián de biǎoyǎn bǐ qùnián de gèng yǒu yìsi, wǒ juéde nǐ yīnggāi lái kàn.
examples.english: This year's performance is even more interesting than last year's; I think you should come see it.

examples.chinese: A:從學校到博物館去，應該往哪個方向走？ B:我看過地圖，應該往南走。
examples.pinyin: A: Cóng xuéxiào dào bówùguǎn qù, yīnggāi wǎng nǎge fāngxiàng zǒu? B: Wǒ kànguo dìtú, yīnggāi wǎng nán zǒu.
examples.english: A: From the school to the museum, which direction should we go? B: I've looked at the map; we should go south.

examples.chinese: 最近感冒的人很多，大人、小孩都應該多注意身體。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn gǎnmào de rén hěn duō, dàrén, xiǎohái dōu yīnggāi duō zhùyì shēntǐ.
examples.english: Recently many people have colds; both adults and children should pay more attention to their health.

examples.chinese: 我不知道那個地方怎麼去，所以應該先查查地圖。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdào nàge dìfāng zěnme qù, suǒyǐ yīnggāi xiān chácha dìtú.
examples.english: I don't know how to get to that place, so I should first check the map.

examples.chinese: 現在很晚了，你應該去睡覺了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài hěn wǎn le, nǐ yīnggāi qù shuìjiào le.
examples.english: It's very late now; you should go to sleep.

examples.chinese: 醫生說，我應該多喝水，不需要吃藥。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō, wǒ yīnggāi duō hē shuǐ, bù xūyào chī yào.
examples.english: The doctor said I should drink more water and don't need to take medicine.

examples.chinese: 最近很多人感冒，大家應該注意身體健康。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn hěn duō rén gǎnmào, dàjiā yīnggāi zhùyì shēntǐ jiànkāng.
examples.english: Recently many people have caught colds; everyone should pay attention to their body's health.

examples.chinese: 我最近太胖了，應該多運動，少吃一點飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn tài pàng le, yīnggāi duō yùndòng, shǎo chī yīdiǎn fàn.
examples.english: I've gotten too fat recently; I should exercise more and eat a little less food.

examples.chinese: 老師明天要考三十個中國字，我應該開始練習了。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī míngtiān yào kǎo sānshí ge Zhōngguó zì, wǒ yīnggāi kāishǐ liànxí le.
examples.english: The teacher will test thirty Chinese characters tomorrow, so I should start practicing.

examples.chinese: 我不懂他的意思，不知道應該說什麼，所以有點兒緊張。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù dǒng tā de yìsi, bù zhīdào yīnggāi shuō shénme, suǒyǐ yǒudiǎnr jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: I don't understand what he means and don't know what I should say, so I am a bit nervous.

examples.chinese: 我們應該常常說請、謝謝。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi chángcháng shuō qǐng, xièxie.
examples.english: We should say ‘please’, ‘thank you’ often.

examples.chinese: 他發燒了？那他應該去看醫生。
examples.pinyin: Tā fāshāo le? Nà tā yīnggāi qù kàn yīshēng.
examples.english: He has a fever? He should see a doctor then.

examples.chinese: 對，我應該多注意身體健康。
examples.pinyin: Duì, wǒ yīnggāi duō zhùyì shēntǐ jiànkāng.
examples.english: You are right. I should pay more attention to it.

examples.chinese: 妳可以帶一些水果去看國安，跟他說應該多喝水，也要多休息。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ dài yìxiē shuǐguǒ qù kàn Guó'ān, gēn tā shuō yīnggāi duō hē shuǐ, yě yào duō xiūxí.
examples.english: You can take some fruit to visit Guoan. Tell him to drink plenty of water and get much rest as well.

examples.chinese: 你不要常常在家上網、看電腦、玩手機，應該去運動。明天我有空，我們可以一起去騎腳踏車。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyào chángcháng zài jiā shàngwǎng, kàn diànnǎo, wán shǒujī, yīnggāi qù yùndòng. Míngtiān wǒ yǒukòng, wǒmen kěyǐ yìqǐ qù qí jiǎotàchē.
examples.english: Don’t surf the internet, use the computer or play on the cell phone at home often. You should go exercise. I am available tomorrow. We can go ride bikes together.

examples.chinese: 客人看了那件洋裝一眼就走了，應該不喜歡吧。
examples.pinyin: Kèrén kàn le nà jiàn yángzhuāng yì yǎn jiù zǒu le, yīnggāi bù xǐhuān ba.
examples.english: The customer took one glance at that dress and then left; she probably doesn't like it.

examples.chinese: 人的一生只有短短幾十年，應該把握時間，讓生活過得充實、 快樂。
examples.pinyin: Rén de yìshēng zhǐyǒu duǎnduǎn jǐ shí nián, yīnggāi bǎwò shíjiān, ràng shēnghuó guò de chōngshí, kuàilè.
examples.english: A person's whole life is only a short few decades; one should grasp time and make life fulfilling and happy.

examples.chinese: 總統處理任何問題時，最先想到的應該是國家的利益，不是個人的利益。
examples.pinyin: Zǒngtǒng chǔlǐ rènhé wèntí shí, zuì xiān xiǎngdào de yīnggāi shì guójiā de lìyì, bú shì gèrén de lìyì.
examples.english: When the president handles any issue, what he should think of first is the nation's interests, not personal interests.

examples.chinese: 做好環境保護的工作，是每個現代人應盡的責任。
examples.pinyin: Zuò hǎo huánjìng bǎohù de gōngzuò, shì měi ge xiàndài rén yīng jìn de zérèn.
examples.english: Doing a good job in environmental protection is the responsibility that every modern person should fulfill.

examples.chinese: 有時候孩子不明白自己到底犯了什麼錯，父母應該好好跟他們溝通。
examples.pinyin: Yǒushíhou háizi bù míngbai zìjǐ dàodǐ fàn le shénme cuò, fùmǔ yīnggāi hǎohǎo gēn tāmen gōutōng.
examples.english: Sometimes children don't understand what mistake they have actually made; parents should communicate well with them.

examples.chinese: A:我對何小姐是真心的，為什麼她一直不肯接受呢？ B:你應該更關心她、更體貼她，讓她知道你是真心愛她的。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ duì Hé xiǎojiě shì zhēnxīn de, wèishénme tā yìzhí bù kěn jiēshòu ne? B: Nǐ yīnggāi gèng guānxīn tā, gèng tǐtiē tā, ràng tā zhīdào nǐ shì zhēnxīn ài tā de.
examples.english: A: I am sincere toward Miss He; why does she keep refusing to accept me? B: You should care about her more and be more considerate of her, so she knows you truly love her.

examples.chinese: 博物館裡的東西非常寶貴， 它們具有民族和文化的價值， 沒辦法用錢算清楚的。每個人的生命價值都是一樣的，不應該為了自己的利益而犧牲別人。
examples.pinyin: 1. Bówùguǎn lǐ de dōngxi fēicháng bǎoguì, tāmen jùyǒu mínzú hé wénhuà de jiàzhí, méi bànfǎ yòng qián suàn qīngchu de. 2. Měi gè rén de shēngmìng jiàzhí dōu shì yīyàng de, bù yīnggāi wèile zìjǐ de lìyì ér xīshēng biérén.
examples.english: 1. The things in the museum are very precious; they have ethnic and cultural value and cannot be calculated clearly with money. 2. Everyone's value of life is the same; one should not sacrifice others for one's own interests.

examples.chinese: 飲食與健康有密切的關係，所以人人都應該按時吃三餐。
examples.pinyin: Yǐnshí yǔ jiànkāng yǒu mìqiè de guānxì, suǒyǐ rénrén dōu yīnggāi ànshí chī sān cān.
examples.english: Diet and health have a close relationship, so everyone should eat three meals on time.

examples.chinese: 儘管這次推銷新產品的活動辦得很順利，顧客的反應也很好，不過還是有需要改進的地方。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn zhè cì tuīxiāo xīn chǎnpǐn de huódòng bàn de hěn shùnlì, gùkè de fǎnyìng yě hěn hǎo, bùguò háishì yǒu xūyào gǎijìn de dìfāng.
examples.english: Although this event to promote the new product went very smoothly and customers' reactions were also very good, there are still areas that need improvement.

examples.chinese: 每個人的一生都應該好好規劃，日子才不會白白地過去。導遊忘了跟小湯約好在紅毛城門口見面，害他白（白）等了一個小時。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè rén de yīshēng dōu yīnggāi hǎohǎo guīhuà, rìzi cái bù huì báibái de guòqù. Dǎoyóu wàng le gēn Xiǎo Tāng yuēhǎo zài Hóngmáochéng ménkǒu jiànmiàn, hài tā bái (bái) děng le yī gè xiǎoshí.
examples.english: Everyone should plan their life well so that days won't pass for nothing. The tour guide forgot to agree to meet Xiao Tang at the entrance of Fort San Domingo, causing him to wait in vain for an hour.

examples.chinese: 照顧還沒成年的孩子是父母應盡的責任，無論如何，既然生了就該養他、教導他。
examples.pinyin: Zhàogù hái méi chéngnián de háizi shì fùmǔ yīng jìn de zérèn, wúlùnrúhé, jìrán shēng le jiù gāi yǎng tā, jiàodǎo tā.
examples.english: Taking care of children who are not yet adults is a responsibility parents should fulfill; in any case, since you gave birth to them, you should raise them and educate them.

examples.chinese: 在雲端科技發達的時代裡，人人都能夠透過網路交友、學習。
examples.pinyin: Zài yúnduān kējì fādá de shídài lǐ, rénrén dōu nénggòu tòuguò wǎnglù jiāoyǒu, xuéxí.
examples.english: In an era of advanced cloud technology, everyone can make friends and learn through the internet.

examples.chinese: 理論上，有空氣、水、食物就可以維持生命，但還是得看實際的情況。著名的科學家愛因斯坦（ Àiyīnsītǎn, Albert Einstein）發明了相對論（Theory of Relativity），這個理論對後來的科學研究產生了重大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Lǐlùn shàng, yǒu kōngqì, shuǐ, shíwù jiù kěyǐ wéichí shēngmìng, dàn háishì děi kàn shíjì de qíngkuàng. Zhùmíng de kēxuéjiā Àiyīnsītǎn fāmíng le xiāngduìlùn, zhège lǐlùn duì hòulái de kēxué yánjiū chǎnshēng le zhòngdà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: In theory, with air, water, and food, life can be maintained, but it still depends on the actual situation. The famous scientist Albert Einstein developed the theory of relativity; this theory had a major impact on later scientific research.

examples.chinese: 這兩家公司在科技方面合作了很多年，也在科學雜誌上發表了共同的研究成果。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng jiā gōngsī zài kējì fāngmiàn hézuò le hěn duō nián, yě zài kēxué zázhì shàng fābiǎo le gòngtóng de yánjiū chéngguǒ.
examples.english: These two companies have cooperated in technology for many years and have also published mutual research results in science magazines.

examples.chinese: 路邊的攝影機錄到了房先生發生車禍的經過，讓警察順利抓到了害他受傷的人。
examples.pinyin: Lùbiān de shèyǐngjī lù dào le Fáng xiānsheng fāshēng chēhuò de jīngguò, ràng jǐngchá shùnlì zhuā dào le hài tā shòushāng de rén.
examples.english: The roadside camera recorded the course of Mr. Fang's car accident, allowing the police to smoothly catch the person who injured him.

examples.chinese: 科學家發明了電燈，改變了人類的生活方式，也大大提高了生活品質。網路是很偉大的發明，就算不出門，也能讓人們得到全球各地的訊息。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā fāmíng le diàndēng, gǎibiàn le rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì, yě dàdà tígāo le shēnghuó pǐnzhí. Wǎnglù shì hěn wěidà de fāmíng, jiùsuàn bù chūmén, yě néng ràng rénmen dédào quánqiú gèdì de xùnxí.
examples.english: Scientists invented the electric light, which changed the lifestyle of mankind and also greatly improved the quality of life. The Internet is a great invention; even without going out, it can let people get information from all over the world.

examples.chinese: 今天上午學校附近發生了車禍，經過警察處理後，現在交通已恢復正常。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shàngwǔ xuéxiào fùjìn fāshēng le chēhuò, jīngguò jǐngchá chǔlǐ hòu, xiànzài jiāotōng yǐ huīfù zhèngcháng.
examples.english: This morning a car accident occurred near the school. After the police handled it, traffic has now returned to normal.

examples.chinese: 我每次寫完考卷都會仔細檢查一遍，要是發現錯誤就馬上改過來。費太太結婚後才發現這是個錯誤決定，她不知道該怎麼辦才好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi cì xiě wán kǎojuàn dōu huì zǐxì jiǎnchá yí biàn, yàoshi fāxiàn cuòwù jiù mǎshàng gǎi guòlái. Fèi tàitai jiéhūn hòu cái fāxiàn zhè shì ge cuòwù juédìng, tā bù zhīdào gāi zěnme bàn cái hǎo.
examples.english: Every time I finish writing an exam paper, I carefully check it once; if I find a mistake, I immediately correct it. Mrs. Fei only discovered after marriage that this was a wrong decision, and she doesn't know what to do.

examples.chinese: 為了避免兒童發生意外，家長在樓梯邊裝了安全網。
examples.pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn értóng fāshēng yìwài, jiāzhǎng zài lóutī biān zhuāng le ānquán wǎng.
examples.english: To avoid accidents involving children, the parents installed a safety net beside the stairs.

examples.chinese: 陸教授在自己的網站上發表有關教學和研究的成果，相當值得參考。
examples.pinyin: Lù jiàoshòu zài zìjǐ de wǎngzhàn shàng fābiǎo yǒuguān jiàoxué hé yánjiū de chéngguǒ, xiāngdāng zhídé cānkǎo.
examples.english: Professor Lu publishes the results of teaching and research on his own website, which are quite worth referring to.

examples.chinese: 那家店的門是自動的，只要站到門前就會自動打開。這棟大樓有安全系統的設備，小偷進去就會自動發出警告的聲音通知警察。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn de mén shì zìdòng de, zhǐyào zhàn dào mén qián jiù huì zìdòng dǎkāi. Zhè dòng dàlóu yǒu ānquán xìtǒng de shèbèi, xiǎotōu jìnqù jiù huì zìdòng fāchū jǐnggào de shēngyīn tōngzhī jǐngchá.
examples.english: The door of that shop is automatic; as soon as you stand in front of the door, it will open automatically. This building has safety system equipment; if a thief enters, it will automatically emit a warning sound to notify the police.

examples.chinese: 學生：明天就要大學考試了，我很緊張，怕考不好。 老師：你是很優秀的學生，我相信只要盡自己的能力，好好發揮實力，一定沒問題的。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng: Míngtiān jiù yào dàxué kǎoshì le, wǒ hěn jǐnzhāng, pà kǎo bù hǎo. Lǎoshī: Nǐ shì hěn yōuxiù de xuéshēng, wǒ xiāngxìn zhǐyào jìn zìjǐ de nénglì, hǎohǎo fāhuī shílì, yīdìng méi wèntí de.
examples.english: Student: The university exam is tomorrow; I'm very nervous and afraid I won't do well. Teacher: You are an excellent student; I believe that as long as you do your best according to your ability and fully demonstrate your strength, there will definitely be no problem.

examples.chinese: 不知道明哲今天怎麼了？老師叫了他好幾次，他就像木頭一樣，沒有反應。九二一大地震發生得太突然，不少民眾因為來不及反應，而被困在屋裡。
examples.pinyin: Bù zhīdào Míngzhé jīntiān zěnme le? Lǎoshī jiào le tā hǎojǐ cì, tā jiù xiàng mùtou yíyàng, méiyǒu fǎnyìng. / Jiǔ'èr yī dà dìzhèn fāshēng de tài tūrán, bùshǎo mínzhòng yīnwèi láibují fǎnyìng, ér bèi kùn zài wū lǐ.
examples.english: I don't know what's wrong with Mingzhe today? The teacher called him several times, but he was like a piece of wood, without any reaction. / The 921 earthquake happened too suddenly; many people were trapped inside their houses because they didn't have time to react.

examples.chinese: 史小姐做事很細心，這張表我檢查過好幾次，還是被她發現了幾個錯字。
examples.pinyin: Shǐ xiǎojiě zuòshì hěn xìxīn, zhè zhāng biǎo wǒ jiǎnchá guo hǎojǐ cì, háishi bèi tā fāxiàn le jǐ ge cuòzì.
examples.english: Ms. Shi is very careful in her work; I checked this form several times, but she still found a few typos.

examples.chinese: 商先生從不發脾氣，人也很謙虛，不論別人怎麼批評他，他還是很客氣地說謝謝。
examples.pinyin: Shāng xiānshēng cóng bù fā píqi, rén yě hěn qiānxū, bùlùn biérén zěnme pīpíng tā, tā háishi hěn kèqi de shuō xièxie.
examples.english: Mr. Shang never loses his temper and is also very modest; no matter how others criticize him, he still politely says thank you.

examples.chinese: A:要是你發現男朋友對你越來越冷淡，還常跟女網友約會， 你會原諒他嗎？ B:這麼花心的男人，絕對不值得原諒。
examples.pinyin: A: Yàoshi nǐ fāxiàn nánpéngyou duì nǐ yuèláiyuè lěngdàn, hái cháng gēn nǚ wǎngyǒu yuēhuì, nǐ huì yuánliàng tā ma? B: Zhème huāxīn de nánrén, juéduì bù zhídé yuánliàng.
examples.english: A: If you found out that your boyfriend was becoming colder and colder toward you and often went on dates with female internet friends, would you forgive him? B: A man who is such a playboy is absolutely not worth forgiving.

examples.chinese: 大多數的人認為哲學是一門很難的學問，不容易理解。先生的個性很奇怪，又愛亂發脾氣，除了他老婆，沒人能理解他。
examples.pinyin: Dàduōshù de rén rènwéi zhéxué shì yì mén hěn nán de xuéwèn, bù róngyì lǐjiě. Xiānsheng de gèxìng hěn qíguài, yòu ài luàn fā píqì, chúle tā lǎopó, méi rén néng lǐjiě tā.
examples.english: Most people think philosophy is a very difficult subject to understand. The husband's personality is very strange, and he also loves to lose his temper randomly; except for his wife, no one can understand him.

examples.chinese: 方老師非常有耐心，就算學生考試的成績很糟，也從來沒發過脾氣。
examples.pinyin: Fāng lǎoshī fēicháng yǒu nàixīn, jiùsuàn xuéshēng kǎoshì de chéngjī hěn zāo, yě cónglái méi fā guo píqì.
examples.english: Teacher Fang is very patient; even if the students' exam scores are very bad, she has never lost her temper.

examples.chinese: 這個路口很危險，經常發生車禍。
examples.pinyin: Zhège lùkǒu hěn wēixiǎn, jīngcháng fāshēng chēhuò.
examples.english: This intersection is very dangerous; car accidents often happen here.

examples.chinese: 這場大地震發生後不久，軍人就立刻趕到了災區，協助救災工作。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng dà dìzhèn fāshēng hòu bùjiǔ, jūnrén jiù lìkè gǎndàole zāiqū, xiézhù jiùzāi gōngzuò.
examples.english: Shortly after this major earthquake occurred, soldiers immediately rushed to the disaster area to assist with disaster relief work.

examples.chinese: 強烈颱風快來了，救災中心對民眾發出警告，為了自己的生命安全，絕對別去海邊。小游經常喝了酒還開車回家，太太警告他如果不改掉這個壞習慣，就要跟他離婚。
examples.pinyin: Qiángliè táifēng kuài lái le, jiùzāi zhōngxīn duì mínzhòng fāchū jǐnggào, wèile zìjǐ de shēngmìng ānquán, juéduì bié qù hǎibiān. Xiǎo Yóu jīngcháng hē le jiǔ hái kāichē huí jiā, tàitai jǐnggào tā rúguǒ bù gǎidiào zhège huài xíguàn, jiù yào gēn tā líhūn.
examples.english: A strong typhoon is coming soon; the disaster relief center issued a warning to the public: for your own safety, absolutely do not go to the beach. Xiao You often drives home after drinking; his wife warned him that if he doesn't change this bad habit, she will divorce him.

examples.chinese: 公司向每位員工發出健檢通知，上面寫著檢查時間、地點和需要注意的事情。地震救災人員聽到東邊大約五公尺以外的地方，有人發出求救的聲音，就立刻趕過去救人。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī xiàng měi wèi yuángōng fāchū jiànjiǎn tōngzhī, shàngmiàn xiě zhe jiǎnchá shíjiān, dìdiǎn hé xūyào zhùyì de shìqíng. Dìzhèn jiùzāi rényuán tīngdào dōngbiān dàyuē wǔ gōngchǐ yǐwài de dìfāng, yǒu rén fāchū qiújiù de shēngyīn, jiù lìkè gǎn guòqù jiù rén.
examples.english: The company sent out a health check notice to every employee, with the examination time, location, and matters needing attention written on it. Earthquake rescue workers heard someone send out a cry for help from a place about five meters to the east, so they immediately rushed over to rescue the person.

examples.chinese: A:小張病了三天了，不但全身沒力，還發高燒。 B:最近很多人都這樣，應該是感冒了。
examples.pinyin: A: Xiǎo Zhāng bìng le sān tiān le, bùdàn quánshēn méi lì, hái fā gāoshāo. B: Zuìjìn hěn duō rén dōu zhèyàng, yīnggāi shì gǎnmào le.
examples.english: A: Xiao Zhang has been ill for three days; not only does his whole body have no strength, but he also has a high fever. B: Many people have been like this recently; it's probably a cold.

examples.chinese: 何小姐走路回家時發覺有人跟在她後面，嚇得她趕快跑進便利商店，不敢回家了。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiǎojiě zǒulù huí jiā shí fājué yǒu rén gēn zài tā hòumiàn, xià de tā gǎnkuài pǎo jìn biànlì shāngdiàn, bù gǎn huí jiā le.
examples.english: When Miss He was walking home, she came to know that someone was following behind her, which scared her so much that she quickly ran into a convenience store and didn't dare go home.

examples.chinese: 那棟大樓發生火災時，還好安全人員很冷靜，才能帶著大家安全地離開。
examples.pinyin: Nà dòng dàlóu fāshēng huǒzāi shí, hái hǎo ānquán rényuán hěn lěngjìng, cái néng dài zhe dàjiā ānquán de líkāi.
examples.english: When that building caught fire, fortunately the safety personnel were very calm, so they were able to lead everyone to leave safely.

examples.chinese: 有人說發生大地震以前，小動物會亂跑、亂叫，這是很自然的現象。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō fāshēng dà dìzhèn yǐqián, xiǎo dòngwù huì luàn pǎo, luàn jiào, zhè shì hěn zìrán de xiànxiàng.
examples.english: Some people say that before a major earthquake occurs, small animals will run around and make noise; this is a very natural phenomenon.

examples.chinese: 這條馬路高低不平，為了避免發生意外，開車經過時一定要小心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo mǎlù gāodī bù píng, wèile bìmiǎn fāshēng yìwài, kāichē jīngguò shí yīdìng yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: This road is uneven (high and low, not flat); in order to avoid accidents, you must be careful when driving through.

examples.chinese: 上次出國時，到了機場才發現沒帶護照，這次我絕對不會再忘了。
examples.pinyin: Shàng cì chūguó shí, dào le jīchǎng cái fāxiàn méi dài hùzhào, zhè cì wǒ juéduì bù huì zài wàng le.
examples.english: Last time I went abroad, I only discovered at the airport that I hadn't brought my passport; this time I absolutely will not forget again.

examples.chinese: 發生大地震後，民眾都發揮愛心，主動提供救災的相關用品給災民。
examples.pinyin: Fāshēng dà dìzhèn hòu, mínzhòng dōu fāhuī àixīn, zhǔdòng tígōng jiùzāi de xiāngguān yòngpǐn gěi zāimín.
examples.english: After the major earthquake, people showed compassion and proactively provided disaster-relief related supplies to the victims.

examples.chinese: 那個工人使用工廠的機器時，不小心發生了意外，流了很多血。
examples.pinyin: Nàge gōngrén shǐyòng gōngchǎng de jīqì shí, bù xiǎoxīn fāshēng le yìwài, liú le hěn duō xiě.
examples.english: When that worker was using the factory machine, an accident happened accidentally, and he bled a lot.

examples.chinese: 九二一大地震時，臺灣人發揮了互相幫助的精神，讓人非常感動。
examples.pinyin: Jiǔ'èr yī dà dìzhèn shí, Táiwān rén fāhuī le hùxiāng bāngzhù de jīngshén, ràng rén fēicháng gǎndòng.
examples.english: During the 921 earthquake, Taiwanese people brought out the spirit of helping one another, which was very moving.

examples.chinese: 軍人用卡車把食物和生活用品送到災區，發給需要的民眾。
examples.pinyin: Jūnrén yòng kǎchē bǎ shíwù hé shēnghuó yòngpǐn sòng dào zāiqū, fā gěi xūyào de mínzhòng.
examples.english: Soldiers used trucks to deliver food and daily necessities to the disaster area and distribute them to the people in need.

examples.chinese: 那場強烈地震發生以後，許多國家的專業人員都來救災，讓人非常感動。
examples.pinyin: Nà chǎng qiángliè dìzhèn fāshēng yǐhòu, xǔduō guójiā de zhuānyè rényuán dōu lái jiùzāi, ràng rén fēicháng gǎndòng.
examples.english: After that strong earthquake occurred, professionals from many countries came to provide disaster relief, which was very moving.

examples.chinese: 前面發生了交通意外，為了避免被困在路上，我們還是走別條路吧。
examples.pinyin: Qiánmiàn fāshēng le jiāotōng yìwài, wèile bìmiǎn bèi kùn zài lùshàng, wǒmen háishì zǒu bié tiáo lù ba.
examples.english: There was a traffic accident ahead; to avoid being stuck on the road, we should take another route.

examples.chinese: 因為有人喝酒後開車，造成了嚴重的交通意外，警察和救護車都趕來了。不管出國工作或留學，一定得買個平安保險，萬一發生什麼意外才能得到幫助。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi yǒu rén hējiǔ hòu kāichē, zàochéng le yánzhòng de jiāotōng yìwài, jǐngchá hé jiùhùchē dōu gǎnlái le. Bùguǎn chūguó gōngzuò huò liúxué, yīdìng děi mǎi gè píng'ān bǎoxiǎn, wànyī fāshēng shénme yìwài cái néng dédào bāngzhù.
examples.english: Because someone drove after drinking, it caused a serious traffic accident; both the police and ambulance rushed over. Whether going abroad to work or study, you must buy safety insurance so that in case any accident happens, you can get help.

examples.chinese: 昨天晚上突然發生強烈地震，學校旁的那座橋塌了，還好沒人受傷。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshàng tūrán fāshēng qiángliè dìzhèn, xuéxiào páng de nà zuò qiáo tā le, hái hǎo méi rén shòushāng.
examples.english: Last night a strong earthquake suddenly occurred; the bridge beside the school collapsed, but fortunately no one was injured.

examples.chinese: 地震時要保護自己的安全，最重要的是避免頭部受傷。當地震發生時，我們應該怎麼做呢？
examples.pinyin: Dìzhèn shí yào bǎohù zìjǐ de ānquán, zuì zhòngyào de shì bìmiǎn tóubù shòushāng. Dāng dìzhèn fāshēng shí, wǒmen yīnggāi zěnme zuò ne?
examples.english: During an earthquake, you must protect your own safety; the most important thing is to avoid head injury. When an earthquake occurs, what should we do?

examples.chinese: 醫生說那個病人得住院，要是三天以內都沒發燒、頭也不痛了，就可以出院了。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō nàge bìngrén děi zhùyuàn, yàoshi sān tiān yǐnèi dōu méi fāshāo, tóu yě bú tòng le, jiù kěyǐ chūyuàn le.
examples.english: The doctor said that patient has to be hospitalized; if within three days he has no fever and his head no longer hurts, then he can be discharged.

examples.chinese: 周先生買了一套用真皮做的沙發，坐起來很舒服。
examples.pinyin: Zhōu xiānsheng mǎi le yī tào yòng zhēnpí zuò de shāfā, zuò qǐlái hěn shūfu.
examples.english: Mr. Zhou bought a set of sofas made of genuine leather; they are very comfortable to sit on.

examples.chinese: 今天開會時，經理提到公司打算做市場研究，希望大家下次能發表自己的想法。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kāihuì shí, jīnglǐ tí dào gōngsī dǎsuàn zuò shìchǎng yánjiū, xīwàng dàjiā xiàcì néng fābiǎo zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.english: At today's meeting, the manager mentioned that the company plans to do market research, and hopes everyone can express their own ideas next time.

examples.chinese: A:你怎麼了？看起來很不開心的樣子。 B:唉！工廠發生問題，今天又得加班處理了。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ zěnme le? Kàn qǐlái hěn bù kāixīn de yàngzi. B: Āi! Gōngchǎng fāshēng wèntí, jīntiān yòu děi jiābān chǔlǐ le.
examples.english: A: What's wrong? You look very unhappy. B: Alas! There's a problem at the factory; I have to work overtime again today to deal with it.

examples.chinese: 黃先生這幾天一直發燒，腦子很不清楚，恐怕沒辦法寫劇本。
examples.pinyin: Huáng xiānsheng zhè jǐ tiān yīzhí fāshāo, nǎozi hěn bù qīngchu, kǒngpà méi bànfǎ xiě jùběn.
examples.english: Mr. Huang has had a fever for the past few days, his brain is very unclear, and I'm afraid he won't be able to write the script.

examples.chinese: 國安發燒了，不能來上課，我有點兒擔心他。
examples.pinyin: Guó'ān fāshāo le, bù néng lái shàngkè, wǒ yǒudiǎnr dānxīn tā.
examples.english: Guo'an has a fever and cannot come to class; I am a little worried about him.

examples.chinese: 弟弟發燒了，他要請假。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi fāshāo le, tā yào qǐngjià.
examples.english: My younger brother has a fever, and he needs to ask for leave.

examples.chinese: 客廳裡面有兩張沙發。
examples.pinyin: Kètīng lǐmiàn yǒu liǎng zhāng shāfā.
examples.english: There are two sofas in the living room.

examples.chinese: 最近感冒的人很多，我的同學國安也感冒了，今天開始發燒了。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn gǎnmào de rén hěn duō, wǒ de tóngxué Guó'ān yě gǎnmào le, jīntiān kāishǐ fāshāo le.
examples.english: Many people got colds lately. My classmate, Guoan, got a cold, too. He started to have a fever today.

examples.chinese: 對啊！聽說我們學校感冒、發燒的學生很多。
examples.pinyin: Duì a! Tīngshuō wǒmen xuéxiào gǎnmào, fāshāo de xuéshēng hěn duō.
examples.english: Right! I heard that many students from my school have a cold and fever.

examples.chinese: 我會給你三天的藥。你要記得多喝一點兒水，要是發燒了，就吃紅色的藥。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huì gěi nǐ sān tiān de yào. Nǐ yào jìde duō hē yìdiǎnr shuǐ, yàoshi fāshāo le, jiù chī hóngsè de yào.
examples.english: I will give you medicine for 3 days. Remember to drink plenty of water. If you have a fever, then take the red pill.

examples.chinese: 老師，國安今天要請假。他發燒了，不能來上課。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī, Guó'ān jīntiān yào qǐngjià. Tā fāshāo le, bù néng lái shàngkè.
examples.english: Teacher, Guoan has to take a leave today. He has a fever and he can’t come to school.

examples.chinese: 他發燒了？那他應該去看醫生。
examples.pinyin: Tā fāshāo le? Nà tā yīnggāi qù kàn yīshēng.
examples.english: He has a fever? He should see a doctor then.

examples.chinese: 沙發下面呢？
examples.pinyin: Shāfā xiàmiàn ne?
examples.english: How about checking under the sofa?

examples.chinese: 沙發上面、下面跟旁邊都沒有。媽，妳幫我找，好嗎？
examples.pinyin: Shāfā shàngmiàn, xiàmiàn gēn pángbiān dōu méiyǒu. Mā, nǐ bāng wǒ zhǎo, hǎo ma?
examples.english: It is neither on the sofa, under the sofa, nor beside the sofa. Mom, could you find it for me?

examples.chinese: 我雖然尊敬他，卻不認同他所堅持的觀點。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ suīrán zūnjìng tā, què bù rèntóng tā suǒ jiānchí de guāndiǎn.
examples.english: Although I respect him, I do not approve of the viewpoint he insists on.

examples.chinese: 媽媽實在太會做飯了，只用了一個小時就變出一桌既豐富又好吃的大餐。
examples.pinyin: Māma shízài tài huì zuòfàn le, zhǐ yòng le yí ge xiǎoshí jiù biàn chū yì zhuō jì fēngfù yòu hǎochī de dàcān.
examples.english: Mom is really too good at cooking; in just one hour, she conjured up a table full of both abundant and delicious feast.

examples.chinese: 路旁有很多小白花，我常常摘一些放在書桌上，看著看著心情就愉快了。進辦公室前，別忘了摘下帽子，這是一種禮貌。
examples.pinyin: Lù páng yǒu hěn duō xiǎo bái huā, wǒ chángcháng zhāi yīxiē fàng zài shūzhuō shàng, kàn zhe kàn zhe xīnqíng jiù yúkuài le. Jìn bàngōngshì qián, bié wàng le zhāi xià màozi, zhè shì yī zhǒng lǐmào.
examples.english: There are many small white flowers by the roadside; I often pick some and put them on my desk, and as I look at them, my mood becomes cheerful. Before entering the office, don't forget to take off your hat; this is a kind of courtesy.

examples.chinese: 在臺灣，不少大學教室裡的桌、椅是連在一起的，搬起來有點重。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, bùshǎo dàxué jiàoshì lǐ de zhuō, yǐ shì lián zài yìqǐ de, bān qǐlái yǒudiǎn zhòng.
examples.english: In Taiwan, the desks and chairs in many university classrooms are joined together, so they are a bit heavy to move.

examples.chinese: 桌子上放著很多張紙，都是弟弟要寫的書法作業。
examples.pinyin: Zhuōzi shàng fàngzhe hěn duō zhāng zhǐ, dōu shì dìdi yào xiě de shūfǎ zuòyè.
examples.english: There are many sheets of paper placed on the table; they are all the calligraphy homework that my younger brother needs to write.

examples.chinese: 我要買一張桌子跟四張椅子。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào mǎi yì zhāng zhuōzi gēn sì zhāng yǐzi.
examples.english: I want to buy one table and four chairs.

examples.chinese: 我要買一張桌子跟四張椅子。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào mǎi yì zhāng zhuōzi gēn sì zhāng yǐzi.
examples.english: I want to buy one table and four chairs.

examples.chinese: 我要買一張桌子跟四張椅子。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào mǎi yì zhāng zhuōzi gēn sì zhāng yǐzi.
examples.english: I want to buy one table and four chairs.

examples.chinese: 客廳的桌子上有一個錢包，是不是你的？
examples.pinyin: Kètīng de zhuōzi shàng yǒu yí ge qiánbāo, shì bú shì nǐ de?
examples.english: In the living room, there is a wallet on the table. Is that yours?

items.wordHook: a ⺊(divination crack) rests on 日(sun) and 朩(split wood) legs → the sturdy 桌(table).

examples.chinese: 教育是國家的根本，能改變國家的未來。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoyù shì guójiā de gēnběn, néng gǎibiàn guójiā de wèilái.
examples.english: Education is the foundation of a country; it can change the country's future.

examples.chinese: 這件事我根本不了解，所以沒辦法給你適當的建議。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ gēnběn bù liǎojiě, suǒyǐ méi bànfǎ gěi nǐ shìdàng de jiànyì.
examples.english: I simply don't understand this matter at all, so I have no way to give you appropriate advice.

examples.chinese: 公寓的電梯修復中，請大家改走樓梯。
examples.pinyin: Gōngyù de diàntī xiūfù zhōng, qǐng dàjiā gǎi zǒu lóutī.
examples.english: The apartment elevator is under repair; please everyone take the stairs instead.

examples.chinese: 對任何人的態度，不該因種族、國籍或性別而不同。
examples.pinyin: Duì rènhé rén de tàidù, bù gāi yīn zhǒngzú, guójí huò xìngbié ér bùtóng.
examples.english: One's attitude toward anyone should not differ because of race, nationality, or gender.

items.wordHook: Clear mountain 氵(water) flowing from its pristine underground 原(source) springs forth as a pure 源(spring).

這(this) + 些(some) → these ones: 這些(these).
